purpose: Reconciled source purposes: [1] MetaModules recursively compose canonical components, views, bindings and behavior while preserving component ownership and normal authority boundaries. [2] Define MetaModule composition as explicit references plus semantic delta over existing capabilities, preserving ownership and avoiding copied/shadow definitions.

value.authority_rule: Composition does not aggregate constituent permissions into new implicit authority.
value.closure_rule: Recursive composition is deterministic and bounded by visited identities.
value.conflict_rule: Conflicting same-identity semantics hard-fail or require explicit reconciliation.
value.copy_rule: Composition never requires copying constituent canonical definitions into the MetaModule.
value.delta_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Only semantics introduced by the composition are declared locally. [2] MetaModule defines only new composition/application semantics not already owned by constituents.
value.nested_rule: Nested MetaModules preserve child identities and composition provenance.
value.ordering_rule: Array/file order has no semantic precedence unless explicitly declared.
value.ownership_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Composition never transfers ownership of referenced semantics. [2] Constituent semantic ownership remains with original owners.
value.reference_rule: Constituents are referenced by exact canonical identities.
value.reuse_rule: Existing canonical semantics are referenced, not duplicated.
value.traceability_rule: Resolved semantics retain original identity, owner and component provenance.
